entries.3770e45e07840b99: Mitsui Fudosan is a company that itself secures land, builds buildings, and divides how to use them to earn money into 4 ways. If it continues to hold a building it has built and leases it to tenants, it becomes rent in the leasing business; if it sells it, it becomes revenue in the property sales business; if it does not hold it itself but takes custody of another company's building and manages and intermediates it, it becomes fee income in the management business; and if it operates the building itself, like a hotel or a stadium, it becomes revenue in the facility operations business. Work to undertake construction itself from other companies is limited to new construction contracting, reform, and other work in the 'Other' segment conducted by Mitsui Home Co., Ltd. and others, and its revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥247,300 million, which does not reach 1 tenth of consolidated revenue of ¥2,709,700 million.
